title: Archipel Still Life
text: Products were treated as sculptural forms. Light was constructed carefully, warm, directional, suggestive, allowing viewers to sense an environment beyond the frame: a Mediterranean terrace, a quiet Sunday kitchen, a summer afternoon filtered through linen curtains.
